SELECT pno, name, addr, category, thumbnail FROM place
WHERE type LIKE '%'||#{type}||'%'
WHERE name LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
ORDER BY pno ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (cno, uno, pnos, title, content, created_at, is_public) VALUES (course_cno_seq.nextval, #{uno}, #{pnos}, #{title}, #{content}, SYSDATE, #{is_public})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, pnos = #{pnos}, is_public = #{is_public}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE cno = #{cno}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.cno, c.title, c.content, c.uno, u.name, c.hit, TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'yyyy.mm.dd') AS dbday, (SELECT thumbnail FROM place WHERE pno = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.pnos, 1, INSTR(c.pnos, ',') - 1)) ) AS thumbnail, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply r WHERE c.cno = r.cno) AS replycount FROM course c JOIN users u ON c.uno = u.uno WHERE is_public = 'Y'
AND (title LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR content LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
ORDER BY hit DESC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY
